dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Little deerie! You gotta eat your breakfast, or you're never gonna grow up big and strong!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Aino. There is still Lakkaberry residue hanging from the corner of its mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: ...Hmm. Its recovery is progressing smoothly. In a few more days, we can ask Miss Lauma to send it back to its herd.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Aino. I am sure you know that it deserves to go back home instead of staying with us.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Did the Lady Moonchanter from the Frostmoon Scions not say as much when she came to treat the deer?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Its family might be worried about it. Once it has recovered, it would be best to send it home.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I know! But it's... it's not well yet...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Does your leg still hurt? Do you... Do you wanna go home?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Aino, didn't the Lady Moonchanter promise us that she would come and pick up the deer?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: When the time comes, let's ask her to listen to what the deer has to say again.
